sentences.text: is a fictional character and the protagonist of Square Enix 's Kingdom Hearts video game series .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Square Enix	Square Enix

Introduced in the first Kingdom Hearts game in 2002 , Sora is portrayed as a cheerful teenager who lives in the Destiny Islands and has been best friends with Riku and Kairi since childhood .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Riku	Riku (Kingdom Hearts)	Kairi	Kairi (Kingdom Hearts)
When they plan to go on a journey to see other worlds , they are separated by creatures known as the Heartless .
While fighting against them , Sora obtains a weapon called the Keyblade .	Keyblade	Keyblade
Donald Duck and Goofy then recruit him in their journey across various worlds to aid King Mickey while Sora searches for his friends .	Donald Duck	Donald Duck	Goofy	Goofy	King Mickey	Mickey Mouse
Along the way , the trio protects the worlds they visit from various villains .

In Kingdom Hearts II , Sora searches for Riku and fights against Organization XIII who , like Ansem the Seeker of Darkness from the first game , are attempting to seize Kingdom Hearts for their own .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Riku	Riku (Kingdom Hearts)	Kingdom Hearts II	Kingdom Hearts II	Organization XIII	Organization XIII
Sora has also made supporting appearances in other games from the series , and reprised his role in manga and light novel adaptations of the games .	manga	manga	light novel	light novel

Sora was originally designed by Kingdom Hearts series director and character designer Tetsuya Nomura during a discussion between Disney and Square about who should be the protagonist of the series .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Tetsuya Nomura	Tetsuya Nomura
Wanting an original character , Nomura made various sketches of Sora until the design met the approval of Disney .

Nomura came to regard Sora as his favorite character that he had designed , and pushed for the character to have a leading role in the Kingdom Hearts story in spite of the character 's youth .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)
Throughout the series , Sora has been voiced by Haley Joel Osment in the English version and Miyu Irino in the Japanese version .	Haley Joel Osment	Haley Joel Osment	Miyu Irino	Miyu Irino

For his depiction as a child in the prequel Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep , Sora was voiced by Luke Manriquez and Takuto Yoshinaga in English and Japanese , respectively .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep	Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep
Sora 's character has received generally positive critical response due to his warm personality and adventurous spirit .
His personal and martial growth in the series also received praise , especially in his appearance in Kingdom Hearts II .	Kingdom Hearts	Kingdom Hearts (video game)	Kingdom Hearts II	Kingdom Hearts II
Additionally , Sora has ranked high on various video game character popularity polls .
